metadata.title: Shiki No Uta · EchLub browser cover demo

provenance.sourceDescription: Owner-provided legal piano score, three standard-tuning guitar-tab screenshots and descriptor-only analysis of an owner-purchased recording; form, tempo relationship, voicing contour, rhythmic density and broad energy trajectory are reference-guided, while drums, bass treatment and timbre are original cover design.

notes: The piano score confirms a 90 BPM slow pulse, five-flat key signature and broad melodic/harmonic contour.

The standard-tuning tab confirms a 78-bar written timeline, 4/4, 185 BPM at bar 1, 179 BPM at bar 21, Segno at bar 26, To Coda at bar 35, D.S. al Coda at bar 57, later repeat endings and a diminuendo across bars 75-78.

Demucs htdemucs stems and librosa analysis locate a stable 92.285 BPM MP3 pulse, an initial complete B-flat-minor downbeat around 4.16 seconds, drums entering around performance bar 11-12, a breakdown near bar 47 and outro subtraction after bar 103.
The recurring two-bar foundation is Bbm-centered: a Bbm bass bar followed by Ebm-to-Fm/F7 turnaround color anticipating the next Bbm, not a four-chord-per-bar loop.
Vocal pYIN contours are scale-corrected against the five-flat PDF and manually reduced; Demucs bleed and octave errors are not copied into the pack.
Drums, bass treatment, vinyl texture, synth envelopes, filters, spatial effects and live recomposition are explicitly original cover design.

scenes.title: Preroll + Intro · score mm. 1–3
scenes.description: One production preroll bar, then the score's three-measure Intro with piano, guitar and bass foundation.

scenes.title: A · score mm. 4–12
scenes.description: The first written theme enters; the scene length follows the score instead of an audio-derived loop.

scenes.title: B · score mm. 13–20
scenes.description: The B section adds the denser ensemble response shown in the score.

scenes.title: Sax trading · score mm. 21–28
scenes.description: Written tenor and alto phrases trade over the continuing rhythm section.

scenes.title: C · score mm. 29–36
scenes.description: The Segno section begins at written measure 29.

scenes.title: D · score mm. 37–44
scenes.description: The written D section reaches the To Coda marker at measure 44.

scenes.title: Interlude · score mm. 45–52
scenes.description: Sax rests while piano, guitar, bass and drums carry the eight-measure interlude.

scenes.title: Solo · alto pass 1 · score mm. 53–60
scenes.description: First improvised solo chorus over the score's notated harmonic framework.

scenes.title: Solo · alto pass 2 · score mm. 53–60
scenes.description: Second alto chorus; variation is performance-authored, harmony remains score-bound.

scenes.title: Solo · tenor pass 1 · score mm. 53–60
scenes.description: First tenor chorus over the same written eight-measure solo framework.

scenes.title: Solo · tenor pass 2 · score mm. 53–60
scenes.description: Second tenor chorus completes the score's 'Solos 2x each' instruction.

scenes.title: Second ending + D.S. · score mm. 61–65
scenes.description: The second ending leads to D.S. al Coda at written measure 65.

scenes.title: D.S. return · C · score mm. 29–36
scenes.description: Playback obeys the Segno and returns to section C using the same materials.

scenes.title: D.S. return · D · score mm. 37–44
scenes.description: The repeated D section reaches To Coda and jumps out at written measure 44.

scenes.title: Coda entry · drum solo · score m. 66
scenes.description: The score-marked one-measure drum feature clears all pitched layers.

scenes.title: Coda · score mm. 67–73
scenes.description: The written ensemble hits close the score; no unrelated outro loop is substituted.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Define the opening
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Hold the full groove back. Let the listener enter through memory.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Open phrase editor
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Select the opening fragment draft.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Add a note
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Place a new note in the phrase grid.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Move final note
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Drag the last note later to open space.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Close the room
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Low-pass the harmonic bed and leave the texture distant.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Private cue
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Audition the fragment without sending it to master.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Draft ready
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: The opening fragment is now reusable by Story.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Accept offered draft
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Drag the opening fragment into the shared queue.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Launch Scene A
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Commit the first scene to the master timeline.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Open sequencer
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Build a sparse groove under the memory layer.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Toggle step
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Add a ghost hit on beat two.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Toggle step
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Add an offbeat accent.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Remove step
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Clear an overcrowded subdivision.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Reveal low mids
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Gradually make room for bass and harmony.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Preview groove
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Listen against the active opening before offering it.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Quantize 1/16
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Snap steps to the sixteenth grid.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Offer sparse groove
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Make the groove available to Story at the next phrase boundary.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Queue Groove Established
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Accept Pulse's draft and add the bass layer.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Launch Scene B
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: The piece now has a stable forward motion.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Open main phrase
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Prepare the recognisable phrase, but do not release it yet.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Cut response fragment
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Copy the main contour and remove the obvious opening notes.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Private cue response
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Test a shorter phrase against the established groove.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Offer tease
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Send only the response fragment to Story.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Arm echo tail
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Let the fragment leave a recognisable trace after it ends.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Queue Melody Tease
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Hold the full phrase and commit the shorter response instead.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Launch Scene C
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: The listener receives enough information to expect a later release.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Prepare a gap
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Remove the first beat before the full phrase enters.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Main phrase ready
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: The complete melodic draft is now available.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Open the mix
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Widen the spectral space while keeping the bass muted for one beat.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Raise melody fader
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Bring the phrase forward in the blend.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Offer one-beat break
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Attach a timing condition to the phrase launch.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Queue Main Release
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Combine the full phrase, timing gap and wide mix at Bar 28.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Launch Scene D
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: All four brain decisions resolve into one phrase boundary.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Reduce echo
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Keep the main phrase in front after its entrance.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Avoid the expected repeat
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Replace the full phrase with its response and thin the groove.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Queue sparse groove
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Make the recomposition breathe.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Recall response fragment
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Reuse the draft in a different structural role.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Launch Recomposition
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: The expected repeat becomes an alternate take.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Push melody backward
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Let the fragment become memory again.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Recall opening fragment
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Bring the first idea back as an ending signal.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Remove drums
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Leave the final four bars without a full beat.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Close the room
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Return to the distant spectral shape from the opening.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Commit ending
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Resolve the piece by restoring its earliest memory.

livePerformanceChoreography.label: Capture final silence
livePerformanceChoreography.detail: Store the completed 40-bar arrangement in Jam Memory.
